meta.name: InWonder
meta.description:
Shows about the worlds of science, technology and knowledge. Prepare to be taken on a factual adventure!

Shows: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Stalin's Atomic Bunker", Xploration Earth 2050 S2 - "Transforming How Things Are Made", Engineering Reborn S1 - "St. Louis Aquarium, Museum of African Art, Television Centre", Engineering Reborn S1 - "Tate Modern, TWA Hotel, Tropical Island Resort", War Factories S2 - "Apocalypse Factories"
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
